title: A Toddler Video Sold for $760,999 Then Left YouTube

scenes.text: A baby bit a finger. It sold for $760,999.
It's Charlie Bit My Finger, uploaded to YouTube in 2007.
By 2021 it had more than 880 million views.
It sold as an NFT in an online auction. The winning bid: $760,999.
The buyer was an anonymous account.
And the original was announced for deletion from YouTube.
